create_gumbel_distribution: create a Gumbel distribution with location and scale parameters for probabilistic modeling
sample_gumbel_distribution: sample random values from a Gumbel distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob_gumbel: compute the log probability of a value under a Gumbel distribution
calculate_entropy_gumbel: calculate the Shannon entropy in nats for a Gumbel distribution
compute_kl_divergence_gumbel: compute the KL divergence between two Gumbel distributions using the registered TFP function
